A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
5S rDNA fingerprinting can be a useful tool to compare prokaryotic communities in a culture-independent way and that it may be a good complement to culture-dependent methodologies.

the 5S rDNA fingerprinting approach, which is a PCR-free method, is a powerful tool to study the structure of prokaryotic communities in hypersaline environments, and to compare the results obtained with culture-dependent methodologies.
